استخلصوا (form X)
# اِسْتَخْلَصُوا (istaḵlaṣū) /is.tax.la.sˤuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَخْلَصَ (istaḵlaṣa)
# اُسْتُخْلِصُوا (ustuḵliṣū) /us.tux.li.sˤuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَخْلَصَ (istaḵlaṣa)
# اِسْتَخْلِصُوا (istaḵliṣū) /is.tax.li.sˤuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَخْلَصَ (istaḵlaṣa)
